## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is the *Nirvāṇa-śāstra* attributed to [天親菩薩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A9%E8%A6%AA%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9) Vasubandhu, translated by [達磨菩提](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%94%E7%A3%A8%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90) Dharmabodhi during his Northern-Wèi activity. The work is one of the principal Indian *śāstra*-commentaries on the Mahāyāna *parinirvāṇa* doctrine.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Dharmabodhi's Northern-Wèi period (508–535 CE).
